html:
Makarios III was archbishop of Cyprus from 1950 and first president of the Republic of Cyprus from 1960 until his death in 1977. He was born in 1913 in the village of Panayia in the Paphos hills.

As archbishop he led the Greek Cypriot campaign for union with Greece and backed the EOKA revolt, for which Britain exiled him. He then accepted independence instead and became president in 1960. His proposals to change the constitution in 1963 set off the intercommunal fighting. He drifted from enosis toward an independent, non aligned Cyprus, which angered the junta in Athens. In July 1974 it overthrew him in a coup, which gave Turkey the reason for its invasion. He returned and ruled a divided island.
